rows.en: Ymir: "...Any response?"
Sisk: "No..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan..."
Miyasco: "Oh! Vorlia's starting to collapse!"
Aurelie: "Not yet...?"
Celica: "..."
Xiujian: "...This is as far as we can go."
Fain: "!? Y-You..."
Xiujian: "It's dangerous to stay here any longer."
Fain: "Are you going to abandon them?!
And you call yourself their comrade?!"
Xiujian: "..."
Fain: "!! Say something..."
Celica: "Fain, stop!"
Fain: "Princess, don't stop me!
A man like this..."
Celica: "Idiot!"
Fain: "P-Princess...?"
Celica: "Do you think it's easy for him to say that?!
You aren't the only one hurting!"
Fain: "...!! Xiujian... You...
Your hand's bleeding..."
Xiujian: "...It's nothing serious."
Fain: "...I'm sorry...
It's just as hard for you..."
Xiujian: "...Don't worry about it."
Clovis: "Ymir."
Ymir: "...Liebhofen will now withdraw
from this airspace... Captain, may we?"
Captain Roa: "...Hmm."
Baren: "...Liebhofen, moving out."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... Ai-chan..."
Kururu: "Hey, Touya and the others... They'll come back, right?"
Ymir: "Of course.
Nothing like that could happen to those two.
It's all right... They'll come back... I'm sure of it..."
Teacher: "...is........still........though...
............will do that, then. Um..."
Koichiro: "...ouya... Touya, come on...
Falling asleep on the first day is bad... Heeey..."
Teacher: "..."
Koichiro: "...H-Hey, Touya! This is bad!"
Koichiro: "The teacher's coming this way... Hey, Touya...
...Well, don't blame me..."
?????: (...I've finally found you...)
Touya: "?!"
Woman: "Touya Kazami..."
Touya: "...Wh-Where... The classroom?"
Woman: "Yes... Welcome home, Touya."
Touya: "...Y-Yeah. I'm back."
Touya: "Wenimas...
Hey, what's going on?
Was I... Was everything up to now a dream?"
Wenimas: "No. It was all real.
And thanks to your efforts, Vorlia was destroyed."
Touya: "Destroyed... Then we won?"
Wenimas: "Yes."
Touya: "I see... We won..."
Wenimas: "Thank you.
Thanks to you, Agarthia... No,
this world was saved too..."
Touya: "It wasn't just my power.
It was everyone's feelings.
All the comrades I believe in."
Wenimas: "Hehehe... Yes."
Touya: "More importantly, what's going on here?
This is the same scene as before I went to Agarthia..."
Wenimas: "No time has passed
in this world."
Touya: "...What do you mean?"
Wenimas: "All the places you've been in until now
are 'parallel universes.'
You've returned from them to your original universe."
Touya: "Parallel universes?"
Wenimas: "Their existence explains quantum paradoxes.
It takes the probabilistic fluctuations of the state vector to mean that 'every possible
outcome' actually exists,
and that this universe is merely part of an infinite-dimensional space,
a 'multidimensional universe.'
It doesn't exist as a physical reality,
but is merely the limit of our human subjectivity.
In other words, there are worlds that exist there,
which humans simply can't perceive."
Touya: "..."
Wenimas: "Hmm... Well..."
Touya: "No, that's enough.
Anyway, there are multiple worlds besides
the one I lived in, right?"
Wenimas: "W-Well, yes."
Touya: "Then the world Kasumi was in was also
a different world?"
Wenimas: "Yes. As I said,
there are as many worlds as there are possibilities
of what could happen in this one."
Touya: "Then Agarthia too...?"
Wenimas: "No, it's a little different. In a parallel world,
there must always be someone who corresponds to you.
But there wasn't in Agarthia, was there?
That's a world in the gap between this world and another."
Touya: "...Just how much did you know...?"
Wenimas: "When I freed my consciousness,
perhaps I touched something that could be called the universe's will.
But I don't know what I can do,
or what power I've gained.
But when I wished with all my heart to save Agarthia,
I only knew what I should do.
So I acted accordingly.
In the end, it meant I used you..."
Touya: "But if every possible world exists,
doesn't that mean you didn't have to do any of this?"
Wenimas: "No. The worlds exist,
but each world is complete within itself.
So even if other worlds exist, what happens
within each one still accumulates as its own passage of time.
I merely sought to save the world of Agarthia,
by gathering allies from other worlds."
Touya: "Then that world of Agarthia I was in
has started moving forward as a world
where it was 'saved'?"
Wenimas: "Yes. And you've returned
to the world where you belong."
Touya: "Then what happened to Ai? To everyone?"
Wenimas: "It's all right. Ai has returned to her own world too.
And everyone's safe."
Touya: "...I see...!!
H-Hey... Don't tell me everyone was from another world,
rather than this one..."
Wenimas: "Hehehe..."
Touya: "It's not funny! If that's true,
wouldn't that mean the Ai in this world doesn't know
anything about me?!"
Wenimas: "Hehehe... Don't worry.
Ai, Kasumi, everyone... They're all from this world.
So don't worry."
Touya: "I-I see..."
Wenimas: "Oh... I'm sorry.
I have to go soon..."
Touya: "...Go where?"
Wenimas: "To the one I love..."
Touya: "?"
Wenimas: "...Thank you so much.
The world I loved was saved... And the one I love..."
Touya: "...I see. Then this is goodbye."
Wenimas: "Yes. Well then..."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Ayaka: "Good morning, Touya Kazami."
Touya: "Good morning, Teacher."
Ayaka: "...You're quite brazen, aren't you?"
Touya: "I'm sorry. I'll be more careful."
Ayaka: "I-I see... Then please do.
And next time, wake up before you say it."
Touya: "Huh..."
And so my battle came to an end.
The days I spent in Agarthia became precious memories,
<FC:5A:3E> and the people I met there became irreplaceable friends.
<FC:5A:3E> I don't know what happened to everyone.
But I'm sure they feel as clear and bright
<FC:5A:3E> as this blue sky...
<FC:5A:3E> For some reason, that's what I felt.
Ordinary life begins again, and a new everyday life begins...
<FC:5A:3E> What once seemed dull now looks radiant.
<FC:5A:3E> Because...
Yamato: "Morning, Touya!"
Touya: "O-Oh... Good morning."
Koichiro: "Good morning, Touya."
Touya: "Morning... Wait, why are you here?!"
Koichiro: "Well, we shouldn't just stand around talking. Let's sit."
Kasumi: "Here you are."
Koichiro: "Oh, don't trouble yourself..."
Touya: "Aaah! Don't make yourself at home in my house!"
Koichiro: "Why are you so angry?
You must be short on calcium.
They say people these days don't get enough."
Kasumi: "Now, now. It's all right, Touya-chan.
Koichiro came because he was worried about you too.
Here, sit down."
Touya: "O-Okay..."
Yamato: "Honestly, don't eat with your elbows on the table!"
Touya: "Yeah, yeah."
Yamato: "Don't hover your chopsticks over the food!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Don't slurp your miso soup!"
Touya: "Aaah! Let me at least eat how I want!"
Yamato: "No. The way you are now, I'd be too embarrassed
to let you out in front of other people."
Touya: "Shut up..."
Yamato: "What?! Is that how you speak to me?!"
Touya: "What's your problem?!"
Koichiro: "...To think you and Kasumi, Touya,
went to another world.
Honestly, there's still part of me that can't quite believe it,
but seeing Yamato talking like this
makes me think it was real."
Kasumi: "Hehehe... Yes. Touya-chan and I
had a strange experience, but for everyone in this world,
it was only a moment."
Touya: "Right, that's it.
You really didn't see Zeifon fighting in the schoolyard?"
Koichiro: "Why would I lie?
You came back on Friday, April 8, Touya.
First period on the first day of classes. There's no doubt."
Kasumi: "It's strange. I didn't know about Zeifon
and Rayblade fighting in the schoolyard either..."
Koichiro: "In the end, the day you had that strange experience, Touya,
Friday, April 8, is when your memories diverged from ours.
And you returned on that same day...
Maybe the frayed loop of time was joined back together?
But giant robots... I wish I'd been chosen too...
Hey, can't you go there anymore?"
Kasumi: "There you go again...
More importantly, eat up before it gets cold."
Koichiro: "You're right. Today's breakfast is more important
than the past. Well then, let's start with
this skewered dried fish... Here, Touya, open wide..."
Touya: "H-Hey! Stop it!"
Koichiro: "Oh, why are you so embarrassed?
It's you and me, Touya..."
Touya: "Don't invent your own fantasy world."
Koichiro: "H-How cruel... Were you just... playing with me...?"
Touya: "...Want me to hit you?"
Koichiro: "Oh, it's just a little joke."
Touya: "...It doesn't sound like a joke when you do it, so stop."
Kasumi: "All right, all right. Isn't that enough?
Today's an important day, right, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "Huh? Y-Yeah."
Koichiro: "Oh, right. Today, your beloved, beloved..."
Koichiro: "Ow... How cruel..."
Touya: "Hmph! Munch, munch, munch. Chomp, chomp.
Sluuurp... Chomp, chomp. Gulp."
Yamato: "Touya! Mind your manners!"
Kasumi: "She's right. Even if you're in a hurry,
don't stuff yourself like that.
You have to chew your food properly..."
Touya: "Gulp, gulp, gulp... Aaah!
...Thanks for the meal. I'm off!"
Koichiro: "He left..."
Yamato: "...Honestly, that boy..."
Kasumi: "..."
Koichiro: "...Kasumi, are you all right with this?"
Kasumi: "Yes... It's what Touya-chan chose, after all."
Koichiro: "...I see.
...Still, that Touya..."
Kasumi: "Now, let's eat.
After breakfast, we have to clean, do the laundry,
go shopping, and then prepare dinner.
Koichiro, Yamato, you're helping today, okay?"
Koichiro: "I know. But I'm looking forward to it...
What kind of girl is she?"
Kasumi: "She's full of energy, and a little stubborn...
But she's very kind."
Koichiro: "Well, she's the one Touya chose,
so I'm not worried.
It looks like we'll have a fun dinner tonight."
Kasumi: "...Yes."
Ai: "...Honestly! You're late!
What do you mean by making a girl wait?!"
Touya: "Sorry, sorry... Wait, huh? You..."
Ai: "Wh-What?"
Touya: "So you have clothes like that..."
Ai: "Of course I do. Hey, don't tell me
you thought I'd come in my sailor uniform?"
Touya: "Yeah... Knowing you..."
Ai: "First you're late, and then that rude remark.
Unforgivable."
Touya: "...Don't be so angry."
Ai: "...I don't care!"
Touya: "Hey, hey. This is the first time we've met since getting back...
I'm really sorry! I apologize."
Touya: "H-Hey, Ai..."
Ai: "...Then, Touya, you're paying for all of today's date.
Do that, and I'll forgive you."
Touya: "What?! I'm a student. That's a bit..."
Ai: "No arguments! It's decided!"
Touya: "...Sigh."
Ai: "Then let's get moving! All aboard!"
Touya: "You don't have to hurry so much..."
Ai: "Yes, we do! I've planned everything right through to this evening.
We can't waste a single minute or second!"
Touya: "Yes, yes. Shall we go, then...?"
Ai: "Yeah!"
And so my battle came to an end.
The days I spent in Agarthia became precious memories,
<FC:5A:3E> and the people I met there became irreplaceable friends.
<FC:5A:3E> I don't know what happened to everyone.
But I'm sure they feel as clear and bright
<FC:5A:3E> as this blue sky...
<FC:5A:3E> For some reason, that's what I felt.
Ordinary life begins again, and a new everyday life begins...
<FC:5A:3E> What once seemed dull now looks radiant.
<FC:5A:3E> Now that I know how precious everyday life is...
Reporter: "...As for the sightings around the world the other day,
the mystery of the pillars of light is still unexplained.
In particular, the observation of three pillars in Japan
has strengthened the view that the key to this mystery lies in our country,
and a United Nations investigation team is being dispatched today.
The team is expected to arrive tomorrow afternoon.
Now, our next story..."
